title: 1974 AHSME Problem 29
statement: For \(p=1,\) \(2,\) \(\ldots,\) \(10\) let \(S_p\) be the sum of the first \(40\) terms of the arithmetic progression whose first term is \(p\) and whose common difference is \(2p-1;\) then \(S_1+S_2+\cdots+S_{10}\) is

solutions.text:
For each \(p,\) \[ \begin{aligned} S_p&=\frac{40}{2} \bigl(2p+39(2p-1)\bigr)\\ &=1600p-780. \end{aligned} \] Since \(1+2+\cdots+10=55,\) therefore \[ \begin{aligned} \sum_{p=1}^{10}S_p &=1600(55)-7800\\ &=80{,}200. \end{aligned} \]

Therefore, the correct answer is B.
hints: Use the \(40\)-term arithmetic-series formula for a fixed \(p\)
